## Description

Verify A4/A5 Rx and A4 signed note print layouts, 200 % zoom on all P2 screens, screen-reader labels on clinical controls (vitals inputs, allergy states, reconciliation decisions, sign button state), keyboard path consult → sign.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** axe shows no violations on P2 screens; manual screen-reader pass recorded for N-01, E-07 and sign modal.
- [ ] **AC2.** Full keyboard path from Today → Patient 360 → note → sign → Rx authorise → print works.
- [ ] **AC3.** Print outputs match the designs and include identifiers on every page.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
